title: Lawyer Salary Melbourne: Award Rates and Hourly to Annual Pay Guide for 2026-27
description: Convert hourly rate to annual salary for a lawyer in Melbourne using Fair Work Ombudsman Legal Services Award rates. Includes tax, super, fortnightly pay.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Legal Services Award for Melbourne Lawyers

When researching a lawyer salary Melbourne, the Legal Services Award provides minimum rates for legal clerical and administrative employees, law graduates, and law clerks. The Fair Work Ombudsman sets these rates. For a Level 5 law graduate, the minimum hourly rate is $33.99. For a Level 6 law clerk, it is $36.03. These rates apply from 1 July 2026. Many lawyers are covered, but senior lawyers or those on individual agreements may have different arrangements. Always check your classification and agreement.

## How to Calculate Annual Pay from an Hourly Rate

To convert an hourly rate to annual salary for a lawyer salary Melbourne, multiply your hourly rate by 38 hours per week, then by 52 weeks. For example, $33.99 per hour × 38 × 52 = $67,173.24 per year. This assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime or penalty rates. You can also calculate fortnightly pay by multiplying weekly pay by 2. For a Level 5 law graduate earning $1,291.80 per week, the fortnightly gross is $2,583.60. The formula is hourly × hours per week × 52. This is the same for any occupation. For the National Minimum Wage, the rate is $26.44 per hour, giving $1,004.90 per week and $52,254.80 per year. The Legal Services Award rates are higher.

## Tax and Super on a Lawyer Salary in Melbourne

For a lawyer salary Melbourne, tax uses the 2026-27 resident scale. For $67,173.24, tax is approximately $10,671.97 plus Medicare levy 2% ($1,343.46), total $12,015.43, leaving take-home pay of $55,157.81. Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top. For $67,173.24, super is $8,060.79. This is below the maximum contribution base of $270,830. The Australian Taxation Office sets these rates. Super is not deducted from your pay but paid separately.

## Casual Loading and Other Considerations

If you are a casual employee under the Legal Services Award, you get a 25% loading on the minimum hourly rate. For a Level 5 law graduate, the casual rate is $33.99 + 25% = $42.49 per hour. This loading is instead of entitlements like annual leave. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides a summary of penalty rates and overtime. For full-time employees, overtime rates apply after 38 hours. The Legal Services Award also includes meal allowances and shift penalties. Use the [pay guides](/blog) for more details. The [reference tables](/data) show all classifications. The [timesheet](/) helps you calculate your own pay. For a lawyer salary Melbourne, these award rates are the minimum. Many lawyers earn above award, as shown by the Australian Bureau of Statistics. The average full-time adult ordinary time earnings are $2,083.70 per week. This is higher than the award. Your actual pay may be different.

## Final Notes

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026-27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
